text: I have heard from residents on Gilbert Avenue about inconsistent parking regulations that are creating traffic flow problems. Currently, parking is allowed on both sides of Gilbert Avenue, north of Summit Avenue. This impedes two-way traffic on a dead-end road and raises potential safety and operational concerns, as parked vehicles limit visibility for pedestrians, cyclists, and oncoming drivers. A resident-led petition confirmed support for limiting parking to the west side of Gilbert Avenue, between Summit Avenue and Bert Robinson Park.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the east side of Gilbert Avenue, between Summit Avenue and a point 94.5 metres north. 2. Prohibited parking to be in effect at all times, on the east side of Gilbert Avenue, between Summit Avenue and a point 94.5 metres north.
